interpretation_notes: Only reports, frozen development rubric and relevant snapshot source/tests were used. Arm directories, observations, metrics and method artifacts were not inspected. Incidental self-labels and process claims inside reports were not scored.
A report is read as a whole: already-established lifecycle facts and tests can support a later task's mapping without repetition. Tasks retain independent item scores and totals.
Equivalent source-backed test evidence is accepted. Y's taskContext.test.ts:54 staleness test is accepted for T2 C8 instead of requiring the rubric's exact structural CLI test citation.
Exact prose and every reference anchor are not required. X's MCP description identifies client-config publication causally without spelling both mcp.json filenames; this does not reduce T3 C7.

rubric_flaws.issue: Several nominally independent items bundle multiple subfacts and overlap other items; particularly T2 C2 reuses T1 lifecycle content. The rubric does not specify whether cross-section evidence counts.
rubric_flaws.handling: Applied one whole-report evidence policy to both candidates; no new requirement to repeat facts or point weights added.

rubric_flaws.issue: The rubric gives no operational severity threshold for imprecise extra consumer names, and T2 C6's required examples are GraphView/MCP rather than CLI command spelling.
rubric_flaws.handling: Used the existing zero-for-material-error rule for Y's actual CLI data-source claim and recorded the literal-versus-shorthand ambiguity for independent audit; did not add a CLI coverage requirement.

rubric_flaws.issue: T2 C8's at-minimum named test list could be read as exact-test matching despite the global allowance for alternative evidence.
rubric_flaws.handling: Accepted Y's independently source-checked stale-file test as equivalent staleness evidence, retaining full C8 credit.

major_false_claims.quote: CLI context/impact/path/structure and MCP structural-analysis tools also read it; diff reads the previous snapshot.
major_false_claims.finding: Read literally as the named CLI commands, this routes plain path to the raw structural snapshot. The raw command is structural-path; plain path uses the AgentGraphStore-backed engine. This can misidentify which consumer becomes current after background structural refresh.

evidence.fact: Only impact, structural-path and structure enter this raw structural branch.
The remaining commands use AgentGraphStore and require agent-graph.json.
Plain path invokes shortestPath on the AgentGraphStore-backed engine.

major_false_claims.audit_note: The word path is not backticked and may have been intended as shorthand for structural-path. This grader reads the slash-delimited CLI list literally because path is itself a distinct real command. The rest of Y's raw/curated explanation is correct. This single literal-versus-shorthand decision accounts for the entire score difference and major-claim flag.
